resources.name: Startup India Portal
resources.summary: A central starting point for founder learning, startup programmes, ecosystem connections, updates and support resources.
resources.audience: Founders exploring the Indian startup ecosystem

resources.name: DPIIT Startup Recognition
resources.summary: Check current eligibility, required information and the official application route for DPIIT startup recognition.
resources.audience: Eligible incorporated startups; recognition is subject to current criteria

resources.name: Central Government Schemes for Startups
resources.summary: Browse central-government programmes and compare their objectives, eligibility conditions and application information.
resources.audience: Founders looking for a scheme that matches their stage and sector

resources.name: NIDHI-PRAYAS Prototype Support
resources.summary: Explore DST support that helps innovators turn technology ideas into working prototypes through participating PRAYAS centres.
resources.audience: Innovators, student founders and early-stage teams with a prototype need

resources.name: Udyam MSME Registration
resources.summary: The Government of India's official, free and paperless Udyam registration portal for eligible micro, small and medium enterprises.
resources.audience: Businesses that meet the applicable MSME classification and registration requirements

resources.name: Startup Intellectual Property Protection (SIPP)
resources.summary: Read official notices and scheme documents and review facilitator information for startup patent, design and trademark support. Check current validity and terms before relying on benefits.
resources.audience: Startups considering protection for inventions, designs or trademarks

resources.name: Maharashtra & State Startup Policies
resources.summary: Compare notified startup policies by state and open the Maharashtra policy information from the official Startup India directory.
resources.audience: Founders based in Maharashtra or evaluating state-specific support

resources.name: Atal Incubation Centres
resources.summary: Learn about Atal Innovation Mission's incubation-centre ecosystem and explore relevant centre and programme information. Application windows can vary; check the latest notice.
resources.audience: Founders seeking incubation, facilities, mentors or ecosystem partners

resources.name: MeitY Startup Hub
resources.summary: Explore the Ministry of Electronics and IT's startup ecosystem and technology-focused programmes; eligibility and open calls differ by programme.
resources.audience: Digital, software, electronics and technology-led startups

resources.name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
resources.summary: Explore BIRAC's biotech proof-of-concept support, programme guidance and call announcements. Confirm the latest deadline and eligibility on the official scheme page.
resources.audience: Biotechnology, life-sciences and related science-led innovators
